'''pointy-eared green dude 4000 Years Ago it was Malak and Taris…20 Years Ago it was Grand Moff Tarkin and Alderaan…and now in 2004 it is PEGD and SYCFA! (Classic)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 7 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 SYCFA dude DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Alert My Star Destroyer! (V), The Emperor (V), Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Sorry about the long title, but I found it creative.  :P  When you read on about my deck, you may turn your head and cringe at how poorly it is built.  That is because, when it comes to SYCFA, I am a noob.  I have never played it before…in fact, this is my first rendition of one.  Let me know what you think!
